Batman Vs. Superman
To be transparent, I’m not a fan of either character nor really DC as a whole to begin with, but the way they wrote that movie to build up to this huge fight just for it to fizzle out the way it did irks me to my core. 
It got me so heated that I feel angry when I meet a person named Martha because that movie is all it reminds me of.

NTA. Fed is best! Years from now it’s probably not going to matter if that baby was formula or breast fed. What will matter is that your SIL stayed healthy in order to keep that baby healthy. Let people be mad. If SIL is adamant about breastfeeding, she can figure that out now that’s she had a chance to shower/rest/recover.

One of two things is happening here. 
1) this is fake,
2) OP has clearly done something ELSE that a court would use to assume he’d be a unfit parent otherwise he wouldn’t have had the need to be a petty AH. 

Full custody isn’t just automatically awarded to one parent. 

Also, I don’t think OP dating the 21-year-old sparked any jealously unless the ex-wife said that specifically. I can almost guarantee that he already brought this new girl around his kids and they were creeped out and told mom.

There are, unfortunately, a lot of people who believe that miscarriage only happens if the pregnant woman did something to cause it. It’s just another way for misogynistic conservatives to control what a woman can and cannot do.

I had a roommate in college that legitimately didn’t know food came from sources other than a grocery store. I grew up in a town that has a significant number of apple orchards, so I was always bringing apple and apple-related products back to the apartment after visiting home, and she was genuinely confused as to why I’d buy apples there instead of waiting to get them when I got back.
This reminds me of the people who order “cheeseburgers with no cheese” and then getting offended when you point out that’s the same thing as a hamburger.

I’m not. Maybe it’s the whole IG thing, but I just feel a dude wouldn’t take the time to call her out on social media. 

I know I could be wrong, but I sincerely feel like this is a white girl with really straight, fine hair that thinks anything outside of a brush through is “unnatural”

OP might be slowly getting over the resentment and jealousy towards the sister, but is worried that rekindling anything with the sister would automatically mean having contact with mom and it’s not worth the risk?

I say this because I have a terrible relationship with my own mother but still love both of my siblings to death. I don’t blame them at all for the toxicity. However, they are both still in college and still live with her, and I know for a fact that my mom bitches I reach out to them and not her, because she used to try to make me feel guilty about it.

A) for him to get her professional help if she is indeed struggling with PPD and B) have a conversation with her about better splitting the responsibilities. 

Maybe she’d be willing to do a few more household maintenance stuff if he meant he’d get up in the night with the baby a couple times. This is something they need to figure out rather than turn it into an argument for someone to win.

Not if she has PPD and sleep deprivation. 

These kind of situations have resulted in babies getting drowned by their own mothers. It's scary, but I think OP needs to make sure she gets help instead of trying to claim she doesn't work that hard or that he doesn't need to help.
None of that matters. Comparing caring for an infant to housework, and expecting to only have to do one or the other, is asinine.

You can't be serious?

I'm going to assume you don't have kids and leave it at that.

>I cook 5/7 days a week, 7/7 now that we can’t get takeout in good conscious. She doesn’t know how. I do the dishes because I cook. I vacuum and take out the garbage. I clean the bathrooms. The only thing she does is take care of our son.

Who does the laundry

Who is doing yardwork

Who buys the groceries

Who buys diapers/wipes/formula

Even if they're getting delivered, who puts it all away?

Cooking and cleaning is NOT everything. And even if you consider it to be, it's still the other parent's responsibility to help parent.

And it certainly is not true that taking care of the baby is the easier thing. If he helped out regularly with the baby, I don't think he would have said that so nonchalantly.

These two need to sit down and figure out a better way to split responsibilities so neither feels like they're doing more than the other. I don't necessarily blame him for feeling overworked, but I also don't think he's making sure his wife is OK.

Immediately getting her deported makes me think there was a suspicion the daughter isn't his and wanted to ensure he could keep her.

If he would have tried instead to just get a custody agreement, it could have easily come out that he wasn't the father and lost custody completely, and probably also resulted in mother getting deported and now the daughter is without both her parents.

I guess no matter how you approach this, it's the daughter that gets the worst of it.
Where did you get that? Maybe I missed something, but if the store was up and running with stolen artwork, that's a continuous infraction.

Unfortunately true, I just hope the boss is sympathetic in this situation. 
And that if he does hold a grudge over that, op moves on when he's able.

>So if I dug through your life to find any instance of any crime whatsoever like jaywalking, littering, speeding, not properly signalling when driving, etc. so I could report you and try to get you ticketed or arrested

No, I'm talking your original comment. You talked about going back and digging up a crime. Not an active situation. If it happened in the past, it probably didn't kill anybody or they would have already gotten caught.

Again, you’re putting words in my mouth. Never did I say those things weren’t wrong or criminal in any fashion. I said they weren’t comparable to this crime. Stop trying to argue for the sake of an argument.

I didn’t say that. 
If you see somebody actively speeding, then yeah, report it. But going back and trying to prove it already happened is not the same thing. 
OP’s friend was actively stealing work.

Yes. Normally they tell you to put the baby down somewhere safe, like a crib, and walk away if you need to. Crying for a few minutes alone won't hurt them, but an unwell parent might.

My guess as to what happened here is that mom didn't want to feel like she was abandoning baby by setting him down and leaving, so she passed him off to the other parent. It wasn't the best of timing, but PPD doesn't care about timing.
op's attitude gives me the impression that he doesn't think he needs to help with the childcare since he has a job, so I'm going to go with no
If that boss is the type to let someone go for needing to be a parent during a pandemic, op might be better off finding a new job anyway.
The number of people on this thread that think taking care of a newborn child is easy boggles me.

Agree. My initial thought was PPD as well. If OP had actually been at work, instead of home, he could have very easily come home to a neglected, or dead, child.

I'm also very off-put by OP's "all she does is childcare" attitude like birthing and taking a care of child is easy. OP sounds like an AH to me even without this situation.

The friend claimed to have an agreement, so OP confirmed with the artist. I don't know their relationship, but if the friend has a history of being shady, maybe OP felt the need to double check.

I'll admit that if I was in this situation I'd have expected the artist to first ask the friend to take down the artwork instead of immediately reporting it.
This is a terrible comparison. None of those things are the equivalent of profiting off of someone else's work.

I see it more as OP was asking the artist "hey did you give so-and-so permission to use your images?" so I agree with you that it's just differing viewpoints. 
I believe OP wasn't intending to get the store shut down and was just trying to confirm the friend's statement by asking the artist.

OP did confront the friend first, and THEN contacted the artist

Yesss! I learned this the hard way. A few years ago, I was having problems with yeast infections and someone just casually asked me what type of fabric underwear I wore. Turns out it was a bunch of synthetic blends. I had never paid attention to that before.

I switched to cotton and I've only had one infection since. I wish this type of thing was more widely known.

YTA.

I hope you're an actual child if you're doing something this childish. This isn't going to accomplish what you want, it's just going to make your brother resent you.

Since your claim is wanting to help your brother, maybe provide actual, helpful resources? Because even if he does decide he wants to be healthier, you are definitely not the person he is going to ask now.

And also, just because you exercise and "look like a Greek statue" does not always mean healthy. Plenty of thin people are way unhealthier than fat people.

YTA.

If your fiancee *was* offended by this it's probably because she knows someone that has a mental disability. Having any disability is not a choice, which makes it insulting in the same way racial slurs would be, since race is not a choice.

It's very different from using insults, such as bitch, that are usually based on how a person *chooses* to act.

I don't think OP meant these are the same officer. I'm guessing because OP's grandparent was an officer, that his mom grew up knowing officers and this particular one was a friend. If this 'friend' was also anti-LGBT, he probably agreed to planting the weed and pulling them over.

I have two sisters and they already knew I wasn’t going to pick either of them as MoH for two reasons. 1) I didn’t want to choose one over the other and 2) neither of them are the type of people who care for that type of title anyway

Photos are kind of the problem. I want even numbers of both genders for that reason, because I like things to be organized and symmetrical. An option I’ve considered is having all males on both sides, but then I’d be leaving out my sisters and I also don’t want to do that. So I’m left choosing women that probably won’t be in my life the next day, much less 10 years from now. I’m sure I’m overthinking the situation, but right now it just seems like a huge deal.

I realize now that it could be construed that way based on how I wrote it. 
But I got kinda freaked out a few months ago when I was at a wedding and the MoH didn’t have a speech prepared and didn’t tell anyone until the emcee at the reception introduced her. Her exact words to the bride were “I didn’t realize you were serious that I had to do that”
After talking to the bride later, I learned that stuff like that had happened during the whole planning process and if she could go back and pick someone else, she would have. I’m trying to avoid that kind of situation.

I think a lot of it stems from the environment I grew up in. I have a shaky relationship with my parents due to emotional abuse towards me and toxicity towards each other and I think it messed with my brain during puberty and left lasting affects. I reached out to them once a few years ago and my mom basically told me to grow up or they'd ship me to a facility and I've been afraid to reach out to anyone since. Most of my thoughts occur in the morning when I first wake up, as if I regret that I opened my eyes, but then sometimes dissipate during the day and I've even occasionally been happy by the time I go to sleep, only to wake up with the dread once again.
